cases.input: One person has two assignments on distinct project and supervisory axes.
cases.expect: Both appear without triggering a global single-manager violation.

cases.input: A unit has an approved future parent change.
cases.expect: Pre-change and post-change views remain reproducible from their requested time pairs.

cases.input: A person belongs to several project teams.
cases.expect: Membership is projected as many-to-many affiliation rather than administrative containment.

cases.input: Edges from different axes form a cycle only when unioned.
cases.expect: No false cycle is reported; each axis is validated independently.

cases.input: Units are read at one world time and assignments at another.
cases.expect: The view is rejected as temporally inconsistent.

cases.input: A generated snapshot is imported as authoritative organization data.
cases.expect: The write is rejected because the artifact is non-reimportable.
